notes.title: Huge Update
notes.content:
- Graphic improvements
- Screen Resolution fixed
- Multiplayer fixes

The Screen Resoulution problem keeps us very busy the last weeks. 
If you have any issues please try these steps:
- #1 Start the Game in your max Resolution in Fullscreen Mode
- #2 Start the Game in Window Mode in your desired Resolution.
- #3 OR start in Window Mode and adjust the Screen Size - the Game should scale to any resolution. 

Do not Switch between Fullscreen and Window Mode during Gameplay. This can cause problems.

We do not have Displays with Resolutions under Full HD, so its a bit tricky to test these things.


In case you still have issues, do not hesitate and contact us.

notes.title: Sunday Update
notes.content:
As requested we added a Menu for custom Key Mappings and the ability to invert your Mouse available in the Main Menu and Ingame.
And some Multiplayer fixes.
